# SQLite amalgamation

These files are the official SQLite 3.50.2 amalgamation from:

https://sqlite.org/2025/sqlite-amalgamation-3500200.zip

Archive SHA-256: `387991DE2834B5DA2894119FF4173A9EA0779EA55EBCF53D9A40B24D1DC2484E`.

SQLite is in the public domain. Its source files include the applicable
disclaimer. The `sqlite3` Dart native hook compiles `sqlite3.c` from this
directory instead of downloading a precompiled library.
